reason: After an inner collect_warnings block that exits with an exception, a later warn call goes to the outer collection and the inner block holds only its own warning. A collection is kept in a context variable that the block restores on exit, including on an exception, so an outer collection keeps its own warnings (#565).

ProvFutureRejectionWarning is a subclass of ProvWarning and prov.model exports the same class. docs/reference/model.md renders ProvFutureRejectionWarning, whose docstring says the class stays importable so that a filter written for 3.2.3 keeps working (#565).

Inside collect_warnings, warn with the message probe appends the pair of the message and ProvWarning to the collection and emits nothing under an always filter. prov.read collects the warnings of each candidate format and emits only the winner's (#565), so a failed candidate's warning is not shown.

Outside a collection, warn with the message probe emits one ProvWarning matching probe whose filename is the file that called it. HISTORY.md says reader warnings are attributed to the caller of deserialize or prov.read and not to a frame inside prov, and docs/development.md says recoverable problems are attributed to the caller's frame.
